profile.name: Zhaqian Rouf Alfauzi
profile.tagline: I build clean, useful web and mobile apps for schools, clinics, and communities, from the first sketch to the final deploy.
profile.about:
I am a software engineer based in Kediri, East Java. I mostly build web and mobile apps, and I like finding the simple idea behind a messy problem and turning it into something people can actually use every day.

Most of my work so far has been real systems for real clients: digitalizing a community health center with three Laravel apps in one month, building registration and QR-based attendance systems for an Islamic boarding school, and leading a team on a career center app for State Polytechnic of Jember, where I studied Informatics Management. Along the way I have handled project management, UI/UX design, client presentations, and long-term maintenance.

Outside of code I am active in organizations and event committees, where I usually end up handling design, publication, and documentation.

experience.description: Studied the Android mobile development path in a program led by Google, Tokopedia, Gojek, and Traveloka. Designed and built PlasticWise as the capstone project with my team.
Worked on the Career Development Center app and the SSC SMASA 2024 competition platform. Led the CDC team as project manager and designed its mobile UI.
Digitalized the health center with three web apps: UGD Payment, SPPD Online, and a portal with SSO login. Handled UI/UX, client reporting, and presentations, and shipped all three within one month.

Built and maintain three websites for the boarding school: a company profile, the SMPSR student registration system, and SR Absensi for QR code attendance. All of them have been in daily use for over a year.
Helped record and organize service data at the community health center.

projects.title: PlasticWise
projects.description: Bangkit Academy capstone. An Android app that detects plastic types (PETE, HDPE, PVC, LDPE, PP, PS, and others) and recommends how to process each one. I designed the UI in Figma, implemented it in XML, and built the features with my team.
